login.title: Welcome Back
login.intro: Enter your credentials to access the admin panel

add.title: New Domain
add.invalidSubdomain: It is recommended to use a subdomain (e.g. mail.{fqdn}). You will still be able to send as example{'@'}{fqdn}.

dns.title: DNS Records
dns.intro: Before you can use this domain to send emails, configure your domain's DNS records to verify your domain ownership and to allow us to send emails in your name.

spf.title: SPF
spf.description: SPF is used to verify that an email is actually sent by our server.

dkim.title: DKIM
dkim.description: DKIM is used to verify that this server is allowed to send emails in your name.

dmarc.title: DMARC
dmarc.description: DMARC defines how the receiver should react to spoofed emails.
